message.content:
As of now, Tesla has **not yet launched the Model S in India**, so there is no official retail price available from Tesla’s Indian website or local dealers.  

If Tesla were to enter the Indian market, the Model S would likely be priced in the same ball‑park as its U.S. launch price, adjusted for local taxes, import duties, and currency fluctuations. Based on the U.S. price (roughly $200,000–$250,000) and typical import duties on electric vehicles in India (around 10–15 % plus GST), the Model S could be expected to retail somewhere in the range of **₹1.4 – 1.6 crore** (about $180,000–$210,000 USD).  

Keep in mind that this is an estimate; the actual price will depend on Tesla’s final pricing strategy, local incentives, and any changes in duty rates. If you’re interested in the latest updates, it’s a good idea to keep an eye on Tesla’s official announcements or reputable automotive news outlets.
